question.text: Two positive charges $Q$ and $4 Q$ are placed at points $A$ and $B$ respectively, where $B$ is at a distance $d$ units to the right of $A$. The total electric potential due to these charges is minimum at $P$ on the line through $A$ and $B$. What is (are) the distance (s) of $P$ from $A ?$

solution.text: $\because V_{P}$ is minimum. $\therefore$ $E_{p}=0 \Rightarrow E_{A}=E_{B}$ $\Rightarrow \quad \frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \cdot \frac{Q}{r^{2}}=\frac{1}{4 \pi \varepsilon_{0}} \cdot \frac{4 Q}{(d-r)^{2}}$ $\Rightarrow \quad \frac{1}{r}=\frac{2}{d-r} \Rightarrow d-r=2 r$ $\therefore$ Distance of $P$ from the $A r=\frac{d}{3}$ units to the right of $A .$
